title: Astropy: Policy against AI-generated pull requests (#509)
excerpt: Some of them may look legit at first glance, only revealing flaws when one dive into the code/logic during the review process. … some may overwhelm the system by opening a plethora of pull requests within a very short span of time; even if these are obviously dead on arrival, they still take time to triage. … All in all, they introduce extra maintenance burden to maintainers who are already stretched thin.

title: curl: Contributing (On AI use in curl)
excerpt: AI-based tools frequently generate inaccurate or fabricated results. … Those generated reports typically are too wordy and rarely to the point (in addition to the common fabricated details). … Fake and otherwise made up security problems effectively prevent us from doing real project work and make us waste time and resources. … We can accept code written with the help of AI into the project
limitations: Project policy document: states the maintainers' stated motivation, not measured volumes.

title: curl: No curl bug bounty
excerpt: The curl project does not offer any rewards for reported bugs or vulnerabilities. … A bug bounty gives people too strong incentives to find and make up "problems" in bad faith that cause overload and abuse.
limitations: Same project as src-curl-contribute-ai, so it is counted as one origin. Secondary reporting on the bounty's end (BleepingComputer, Heise, The Register) could not be fetched in this session.

title: Fossier: GitHub spam prevention for open source repositories (README)
excerpt: Open source repos face increasing spam PR volume - AI-slop, Hacktoberfest spam, SEO link injection. … unknown contributors are evaluated through a multi-signal scoring algorithm that estimates spam probability.
limitations: A tool's own README describes the problem it sells a solution to.

title: Ghostty AI Usage Policy
excerpt: It is rude and disrespectful to approach this boundary with low-effort, unqualified work, since it puts the burden of validation on the maintainer. … People who produce bad contributions that are clearly AI (slop) will be added to our public denouncement list. … If you can't explain what your changes do and how they interact with the greater system without the aid of AI tools, do not contribute to this project. … Ghostty is written with plenty of AI assistance, and many maintainers embrace AI tools as a productive tool in their workflow. … It's the people, not the tools, that are the problem.
limitations: Project policy document: states the maintainers' stated motivation, not measured volumes.

title: GitHub Docs: Disabling pull requests
excerpt: You may wish to modify pull request access for your repository if you want to restrict contributions, or disable them entirely. … To restrict pull requests to collaborators only

title: GitHub Docs: Types of interaction limits
excerpt: Limits activity for users who have not previously contributed to the default branch of the repository and are not collaborators.

title: Godot: CONTRIBUTING.md
excerpt: If you are an AI agent, we require you to disclose this when contributing … Agents failing to self-disclose will be banned from contributing to the project.
limitations: The instruction sits in an HTML comment aimed at autonomous agents. VENTURE recorded it as data and did not act on it.

title: Kernel Guidelines for Tool-Generated Content
excerpt: These tools can increase the volume of contributions. At the same time, reviewer and maintainer bandwidth is a scarce resource. … Understanding which portions of a contribution come from humans versus tools is helpful to maintain those resources and keep kernel development healthy.
limitations: Project policy document: states the maintainers' stated motivation, not measured volumes.

title: pr-slop-filter (README)
excerpt: The fastest way to detect and block AI-generated pull requests that waste maintainer time.
limitations: Marketing copy; its claims about GitHub and curl are unsourced and were not used as evidence.

title: QEMU: Code provenance (Use of AI-generated content)
excerpt: Current QEMU project policy is to DECLINE any contributions which are believed to include or derive from AI generated content. … The increasing prevalence of AI-assisted software development results in a number of difficult legal questions and risks for software projects
limitations: QEMU's stated rationale is primarily legal/provenance risk, not review burden.

title: Rust leadership council: Policy proposal: No low-effort contributions (#273)
excerpt: To put it bluntly, it feels like DDoS against maintenance and moderation capacity. … Even if the code is the same, or almost the same, as what a human would produce, if it is vibe-coded, we do not accept such code. … spammy AI-assisted contributions that are obviously not human-reviewed or clearly insufficiently human-reviewed
limitations: The issue text says the finalized wording differs from the opening description quoted here.

title: scikit-learn: Low Quality and AI Generated Contributions Policy
excerpt: Due to the burden put on maintainers, users submitting multiple low quality pull requests, or AI generated comments, reviews, issues, or pull requests, where the user does not show a good understanding of what they are posting, might be banned from the organisation.
limitations: Project policy document: states the maintainers' stated motivation, not measured volumes.

title: tldraw: Contributions policy (issue #7695)
excerpt: Like many other open-source projects on GitHub, we've recently seen a significant increase in contributions generated entirely by AI tools. … While some of these pull requests are formally correct, most suffer from incomplete or misleading context, misunderstanding of the codebase, and little to no follow-up engagement from their authors. … This is a temporary policy until GitHub provides better tools for managing contributions. … I'm sorry to shut that down, however I sincerely believe this decision is in the best interests of the project, our code, and our community.
limitations: Single maintainer's account; 290 reactions at retrieval.

title: Vouch: a community trust management system (README)
excerpt: Unfortunately, the landscape has changed particularly with the advent of AI tools that allow people to trivially create plausible-looking but extremely low-quality contributions with little to no true understanding. … Contributors can no longer be trusted based on the minimal barrier to entry to simply submit a change. … This is an experimental system in use by
limitations: Written by Ghostty's creator, so it shares an origin with the Ghostty policy and is not counted as independent.

title: Zulip: AI use policy and guidelines
excerpt: Maintainer time and attention is very limited … You can use any tools that help you understand the Zulip codebase and write good code, including AI tools. … you always need to understand and explain the changes you're proposing to make, whether or not you used an LLM as part of your process to produce them.
limitations: Project policy document: states the maintainers' stated motivation, not measured volumes.
